flow.name: Sign In — Enter phone and request OTP
flow.notes: The phone field has a +91 prefix. The Send OTP button is a full-width orange button.

actions.label: phone number text input (the editable field next to the +91 country code prefix)
Send OTP — the full-width orange submit button at the bottom of the login card

assertions.label: OTP input field with placeholder 0000 or label Enter the 4 digit OTP

flow.name: Sign In — Enter OTP and login
flow.notes: IMPORTANT: do not remove or patch these actions.

assertions.label: any dashboard or check-in page content that confirms login redirect has completed

flow.name: Leads List — Navigate and verify
flow.notes: Navigate to the NOT_STARTED leads list. Verify leads are loaded.

assertions.label: at least one lead card in the list

flow.name: Lead 1 — Open first lead card
flow.notes: Click the > chevron or the phone number on the first lead card to navigate to lead detail.

actions.label: the > chevron arrow or the phone number text on the first lead card — the navigation target that opens the lead detail page

assertions.label: Dialer call button at the bottom of the page

flow.name: Lead 1 — Click Dialer call and dismiss dialog
flow.notes: Click the Dialer call button in the fixed bottom bar. Chrome shows an 'Open Phone?' dialog — press Escape to dismiss it. After dismissing, the Lead Disposition dropdown (showing 'Select' or the current value with a down arrow) becomes active.

actions.label: Dialer call button in the fixed bottom bar

assertions.label: Lead Disposition label with a Select or current value dropdown below it

flow.name: Lead 1 — Select disposition: Not Interested
flow.notes: Click the Lead Disposition 'Select' dropdown on the left side of the disposition card. This opens a bottom sheet popup titled 'Lead Disposition' with radio button options: May Transact, Txn Completed, Ready to transact, RNR, Reschedule, Not Interested, Disqualified. Select 'Not Interested' radio button, then click the 'Update' orange button at the bottom of the popup. IMPORTANT: Use :has-text() for Playwright selectors, NEVER use :contains() which is invalid CSS.

actions.label: Lead Disposition Select dropdown (the 'Select' text with down arrow on the left side of the disposition card)
Not Interested radio button option in the Lead Disposition bottom sheet popup
Update — the full-width orange button at the bottom of the Lead Disposition popup

assertions.label: Lead Status dropdown is now visible or the disposition has been updated (Not Interested selected)

flow.name: Lead 1 — Go back to leads list
flow.notes: Navigate back to the leads list to pick the next lead.

flow.name: Lead 2 — Open second lead card
flow.notes: Click the > chevron or phone number on the SECOND lead card (not the first one we already processed). If the first lead moved to a different tab, click the new first card.

actions.label: the > chevron arrow or the phone number text on the second lead card in the list (or the first card if the previous lead moved tabs)

assertions.label: Dialer call button at the bottom of the page

flow.name: Lead 2 — Click Dialer call and dismiss dialog

actions.label: Dialer call button in the fixed bottom bar

assertions.label: Lead Disposition label with a Select dropdown below it

flow.name: Lead 2 — Select disposition: RNR
flow.notes: Click Lead Disposition 'Select' dropdown, select 'RNR' from the bottom sheet, click 'Update'. IMPORTANT: Use :has-text() for selectors, NEVER :contains().

actions.label: RNR radio button option in the Lead Disposition bottom sheet popup
Update — the full-width orange button at the bottom of the Lead Disposition popup

assertions.label: Lead Status dropdown is now visible or the disposition has been updated (RNR selected)

flow.name: Lead 2 — Go back to leads list
Lead 3 — Open third lead card
